title: Horizon Implementation Day: Grant Agreement Preparation in Horizon Europe (October 2026)
organiser: European Commission, DG Research and Innovation
summary: The autumn 2026 edition of the Commission's session on what happens after a proposal is selected: the grant agreement preparation process, legal and financial validation, the Description of Action and the most common errors.
covers: An overview of the grant agreement preparation (GAP) process
Legal validation and financial capacity assessment by the Research Executive Agency's Central Validation Service
Writing the scientific and technical Description of Action
Legal and financial aspects, and how to avoid common errors
materials: Video recording, agenda and presentation slides for each session
why: Grant preparation runs on tight deadlines and errors delay the start of the project. Coordinators should watch it as soon as they receive an invitation to prepare the grant.
source_name: European Commission · Horizon Europe events and webinars
